guides.favoredWhen: She watches your E once minions thin and plays around Q and E timers. Swing unpredictably, punish 2v2s.

keyTips.text: She watches your E once minions thin out: swing only into cover.
She plays around your Q and E timers: stagger them.
She scales and pokes in levels 1-5: punish before her Q comes online.

tips.text: From 6 she wins 2v2s: roam first, never answer.
Every E you use is a gank opening for her jungle: never swing blind.
Her support roams on your E: track the support before swinging.
Thin minions invite her E-watch: keep the wave healthy.
Swung plus roamed: the Ahri whose timers never lined up never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: He survives early with shield and Q-farming, then kills with Voltaic plus R. End it before the spike.

keyTips.text: Early favours you: high poke means he concedes the first levels.
Your E engage: the swing is your kill setup, so vary it.
He pings every roam: your map movement is the real threat, so move.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He starts Doran's Shield: poke through it anyway.
He refuses to die, farming with Q: HP now is his kills later, so zone him off.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
His R breaks your E chain: if you grapple, expect the ult to snap it.
Spike denied plus roams converted: the Zed whose Voltaic never flipped it never wins.
